Sjællands Universitetshospital, Køge is a hospital department operating under the broader Sjællands Universitetshospital organization in Denmark. It is recognized in national clinical quality registries for reporting data used in the supplementary analysis of cancer diseases among acute surgical patients [^src1]. 

Within the 2024 annual report for the Acute Surgery Database (Akut Kirurgi Databasen, or AKDB), the hospital is listed as a contributing site for data covering the period from September 1, 2022, to August 31, 2023 [^src1]. Its reported data on cancer diagnoses among operated patients feeds into a national quality improvement effort led by the Regions' Clinical Quality Development Program (Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram) [^src1]. This specific data is utilized to adjust for comorbidities when evaluating indicator 11, which measures 90-day postoperative mortality [^src1].

Because the available evidence is limited to a single tabular mention in the AKDB report, no further details regarding the hospital's specific patient volumes, administrative relationships, or broader operational history are available in this corpus.
